instruction: Navigate to the privacy and security settings in Chrome to view options for cookies, site data, and security preferences.

metadata.explanation: Task requires the agent to navigate to Chrome's privacy and security settings page. The evaluator checks if the active tab URL matches chrome://settings/privacy. Uses existing is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric and get_active_url_from_accessTree getter.
metadata.verification: Reusing existing framework functions - no new functions needed. The task follows the same navigation pattern as the original but targets the privacy settings page.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies navigation to Chrome privacy settings page
Getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) appropriately extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree
Metric (is_expected_active_tab_approximate) correctly compares URLs while ignoring query parameters
Expected URL chrome://settings/privacy is semantically correct for the instruction
Complete coverage: instruction only requires navigation, evaluator verifies exactly that
Data flow is correct: getter output (URL string) matches metric input expectations
No state timing issues: accessibility tree reading works reliably for Chrome settings pages
